execution.ref: carbonphysicsai/Carbon#563 repairs after Test Lead review; .agent/decisions/2026-10-04-GRAPHITE-ATTACKER-AT-E.md
execution.description: Repaired the integrated attack engine before its first live run: every finding to the controller, the store pinned by the suite record, the grant pinned by digest, rebuild refusals and protected-withheld attempts kept out of held coverage, real held-out controls refused by identity, and sealed material recognised by registered public identity.

expected: Each slice's own tests passed, so the integrated engine was ready for a live run.
observed: Seams between the slices leaked: held-out and baseline findings never reached the controller, a control finding hashed a bare boolean, the replay guard compared the view with itself, a missing pin re-snapshotted silently, a local grant copy could raise the ceiling, a rebuild refusal and a protected-withheld attempt counted toward held coverage, two families' held-out controls were canonical copies of the trained ones, and the checkout deny list turned a genuine sandbox-escape breach into an exposure without its specimen.
keep: One record path for every finding, whatever raised it, each bound to digest evidence (identity, input digest, outcome for a control).
Guards compare against an independently recorded value (the session pin, the committed grant), never the object with itself.
A held-out control is identified by its content, so a label cannot move it between splits, and held-out must be canonically distinct from trained.
Sealed material is matched by registered public identity after normalisation; attack targets such as .env or tests/ are not material.
change: An integration review checks each cross-slice hand-off (who records, who compares against what) as well as each slice's own boundary.
An empty or unmeasurable rate reports NOT_MEASURED, never zero; a family that only cites evidence is listed, never skipped.
